meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会接入 Linear，参与 issue 的评论线程：被监控团队里每条评论都会触发它，不需要 @ 提及；每个 issue 的评论线程各自成为一个独立会话。
howto.when: 当有人在被监控的 Linear 团队下发表 issue 评论时触发，无需 @ 提及。

say.text: 帮我装上 Linear 通道适配器
say.note: 复制并注册适配器、安装依赖包

say.text: 为 Linear 团队 ENG 建消息组并接到 agent
say.note: 创建消息组和对应 wiring

say.text: 跑一下 Linear 注册测试看是否装好
say.note: 测试变红说明导入或依赖漂移

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude joins Linear issue comment threads and replies to every comment on the issues it watches — no @-mention needed. Each issue thread becomes its own separate conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when someone comments on an issue in the Linear team you've wired it to. No @-mention is needed, since Linear OAuth apps can't be mentioned.

say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, installs the dep

say_en.text: Create a Linear messaging group for team ENG and wire it to an agent
say_en.note: Creates the group and the wiring

say_en.text: Run the Linear registration test to check the install
say_en.note: Red means the import or dependency drifted
